## Defences enforced by py-qa

Run `py-qa run` before committing. `py-qa rule-doc <identifier>` prints the documentation for any identifier a finding prints, offline.

- `pyqaci.format` (py-qa): Code is formatted by ruff format. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.format`
- `pyqaci.record.invalid` (py-qa): Every record exception names one file, a person, dates and a specific justification. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.invalid`
- `pyqaci.record.budget` (py-qa): The record stays within its total and per-rule budget. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.budget`
- `pyqaci.record.expired` (py-qa): No record exception is past its review_by date. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.expired`
- `pyqaci.record.stale` (py-qa): Every record exception covers a suppression. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.stale`
- `pyqaci.suppression.unrecorded` (py-qa): Every suppression comment or setting has a matching record exception. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.suppression.unrecorded`
- `pyqaci.suppression.blanket` (py-qa): No suppression silences a tool without naming the identifier. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.suppression.blanket`
- `pyqaci.suppression.unscanned` (py-qa): Every Python file can be read, so its suppressions can be checked. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.suppression.unscanned`
- `pyqaci.summary.stale` (py-qa): The generated agent summary matches the configuration. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.summary.stale`
- `pyqaci.docs.dangling` (py-qa): Every listed identifier resolves to documentation. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.docs.dangling`
- `pyqaci.tests` (py-qa): The test suite passes. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.tests`
- `pyqaci.coverage` (py-qa): Line coverage stays at or above coverage.fail_under. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci.coverage`
- `pyqaci-broad-suppress` (Pylint, bundled): Give contextlib.suppress only the exceptions its block is expected to raise, never Exception or BaseException. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci-broad-suppress`
- `pyqaci-sensitive-repr` (Pylint, bundled): Keep credential-named fields out of a generated __repr__. Docs: `py-qa rule-doc pyqaci-sensitive-repr`
- 562 Ruff rules and 70 mypy error codes also block; `py-qa rules` lists every one.
- Never suppress a finding without an exception in the project record: 0 exceptions in `qa/record.toml`, listed by `py-qa record list`.
